title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
description: Standard RAG always retrieves, even when not needed. Self-RAG trains a model to decide when to retrieve (or not), generate responses with or without retrieval, and critique its own outputs using special reflection tokens (ISREL, ISSUP, ISUSE). A single model handles retrieval decisions and generation quality assessment.
authors: Asai, Wu, Wang, Sil, Hajishirzi (UW / IBM / AI2)
